evaluation.primary: Final natural-start mode, all five paired seeds: mutant wall-pass and success, fixed success; same-policy discounted return and path.
evaluation.diagnostic: A blocked wall dash is an actual fixed no-move transition that would cross a wall under mutant. Record first block, repeated same-state same-action attempts, success after block, full mode paths. Sample diagnostics keep per-episode counts.
evaluation.seed_unit: Five existing training seeds, paired intervention, not independent replication.
evaluation.sample_rng: seed = 61000 + 1000*learner_seed + 64*layout_index + repeat; repeat 0..7; exact subset of historic 64-repeat evaluation

mixture.sampling: Independent Bernoulli fixed probability once on branch reset and each world reset; held for full world; goal switch cannot resample.
mixture.rng: Per-worker keys derived by fold_in(PRNGKey(seed), 0x534D4958); not policy, sampler, or teacher RNG. Same uniform streams across q.
mixture.observation: Kernel id and mixture RNG/counters are never passed to actor or teacher.
mixture.world_duration: Existing collector resets at tick 64, including inactive padding after delivery. Preserve this contract. Report started/completed world counts, all transitions, and active valid transitions separately.
mixture.initial_state: All five source checkpoints verified tick=0; preserve source env, policy, critic, Adam, teacher, BatchRenorm, and existing RNG; existing command_delivery change only.
mixture.resume: Checkpoint includes kernel flag, per-worker RNG and all counters alongside full inherited state.

baselines.eligibility: Source SHA, config, origin source hash and commanded full-state digest must match. q=0 and q=1 one-update equivalence checks compare original and mixed paths at full 512x64 before reuse; maximum abs difference <=1e-6, identical original RNG/env/optimizer step counts.
baselines.interpretation: Break-even of the two fixed existing strategies, not an optimal mixed-policy threshold.

document_reconciliation.termination: Inspected source: training world ends at tick 64 only; delivery masks remaining commanded samples. Frozen evaluation ends on success. Preserve both existing rules rather than introduce early-reset training.
document_reconciliation.authorization: User explicitly approved: 검증 통과 후 15 jobs 실행
document_reconciliation.baseline_evaluation: Sample 8 uses the first 8 historic RNG streams per layout; exact raw episode parity required.
